source: supabase.com/dashboard (logged-in project, dark theme): Table Editor home and a table grid
method: getComputedStyle on live elements; colors normalized to sRGB hex (@n% = alpha)

typography.note: Controls are one step smaller (12px) than body text (13px).

color.note: Neutrals carry a faint green hue (oklch hue 157.5). Layers above the base are white alphas, not fixed greys.

material.button: bg #dfdfdf@3% + linear-gradient(#fff@2%, #000@1%); box-shadow 0 1px 3px #000@20%, inset 0 1px 0 #fff@4%, inset 0 0 0 1px #000@6%, inset 0 -1px 0 #000@6%, inset 0 0 0 1px #fff@10%
material.primary_button: bg #006338 with the same gradient and inset rim, no bottom shade
material.empty_state: transparent fill, 1px #f2f2f2@7% border, radius 8px, 32px padding, centered icon + two text lines

radius.base: 0.333rem on a 16px root (≈5.3px) for inputs and kbd
radius.pill: full for badges and the Connect button

layout.frame: Flush, no inset panel: 48px top bar with breadcrumb, 48px icon rail, 256px secondary sidebar, content.
layout.top_bar: 48px; breadcrumb of org / project / branch with chevron switchers and inline badges; actions right with 8px gap
layout.icon_rail: 48px wide, items 32x32 (padding 8px 8px 8px 6px, 20px icons, radius 8px), groups padded 8px with 2-4px gaps; on hover the rail expands over the content to 208px with labels (width 100ms linear, items 150ms)
layout.secondary_sidebar: 256px, 48px header (padding 0 24px, 1px bottom border), controls with 16px side margin, list rows 28px with padding 0 4px 0 16px, 12px icon gap, 15px icons
layout.content: tab strip 48px (#181a19 tabs with 1px bottom border), toolbar 26px controls, content padding 40px with 40px gaps between sections
layout.data_grid: 35px rows and header, cells padding 0 8px, 1px right and bottom #f2f2f2@7% lines, pinned first column with a soft side shadow, 16px checkbox

components.pill_button: 26px, radius full (Connect in the top bar)
components.badge: 17px, padding 3px 5.5px, radius full, 9px uppercase tracked text, 1px border; status badges use a 10% fill, a dark border and a mid-tone text
components.rail_item: 32x32, active bg #ebebeb@5%, idle icon #989a99, hover bg #fff@2%
components.action_card: icon tile 32px round with a dark tinted fill (#0f3058) + title 13/600 Manrope + 12px description, padding 12px

motion.default: 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) for color, background and border
motion.buttons: background, border, color and scale 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)
motion.rail_expand: width 100ms linear; items width, height, padding 150ms

ux_patterns: Navigation shortcuts are taught in tooltips (G then F).
Breadcrumb top bar doubles as the context switcher (org, project, branch) with environment badges.
Icon rail that expands as an overlay on hover instead of pushing content.
Promotional and empty states share one card language: thin border, centered icon, two lines, one action.
Display font (Manrope) only for titles; everything else Inter.
